paragraphs: Ravia bar Kisi, Yoma 42, with the supplied punctuation מב..
Ravin bar Kisi, Chullin 20b. Ravina bar Kisi, Bava Batra 63a; Hyman says this is the name of one and the same person.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman identifies the three cited name forms as one person.

The consulted whole William Davidson Yoma 42a paragraph has Ravya bar Kisi; Chullin 20b has Ravin bar Kisi speaking to Ravina; Bava Batra 63a has Ravina bar Kisi. These are separate textual comparisons. The supplied Yoma מב.. and Chullin כ:. punctuation is retained as source wording rather than automatically recovered printed folios. Hyman’s claim that the forms name one person, and the existing note reporting that claim, remain attributed; no identity is bound.
